changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM brand_categories bc USING categories c WHERE bc.category_id = c.id AND c.code IN ( 'Britvy_trimmary', 'Pribory_ukladka', 'Massazhery', 'Pribory_uhod_koja', 'Epilyatory', 'Elekt_zubnie_schetki', 'Ultrazvukovye_vanny', 'Vesy', 'Irrigatory', 'Tonometry', 'Ingalyatory', 'Medicinskie_pribory', 'Ustroystva_dezinfekciya', 'Elektrogrelki_prostyni', 'Koncentratory_kisloroda' );

changeSet.author: qoldan-qolga
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO brand_categories (brand_id, category_id) SELECT b.id, c.id FROM brands b CROSS JOIN categories c WHERE c.code IN ( 'Britvy_trimmary', 'Pribory_ukladka', 'Massazhery', 'Pribory_uhod_koja', 'Epilyatory', 'Elekt_zubnie_schetki', 'Ultrazvukovye_vanny', 'Vesy' ) AND b.slug IN ( 'braun','philips','panasonic','xiaomi','dyson','rowenta','scarlett','vitek', 'bosch','samsung','artel','tefal','drugaya-marka' ) ON CONFLICT (brand_id, category_id) DO NOTHING;

INSERT INTO brand_categories (brand_id, category_id) SELECT b.id, c.id FROM brands b CROSS JOIN categories c WHERE c.code IN ( 'Irrigatory', 'Tonometry', 'Ingalyatory', 'Medicinskie_pribory', 'Ustroystva_dezinfekciya', 'Elektrogrelki_prostyni', 'Koncentratory_kisloroda' ) AND b.slug IN ( 'omron','and','microlife','philips','xiaomi','b-well','little-doctor','artel','drugaya-marka' ) ON CONFLICT (brand_id, category_id) DO NOTHING;
